# @gravity-ui/graph

> Gravity UI Graph is an editor for node-based diagrams. Its shared scene draws blocks, anchors and built-in connections using Canvas 2D (default) or WebGL2 (`settings.renderer: "webgl"`). At detailed zoom, React applications can mount HTML views for visible blocks.

For the installed core version, start at `node_modules/@gravity-ui/graph/build/docs/INDEX.md`. The links below are relative to this repository checkout.

## Quick Start & Common Scenarios

- [Getting Started with React](packages/graph/docs/react/usage.md): Creating your first graph component with React
- [Layer Development](packages/graph/docs/system/component-lifecycle.md): Creating custom layers (the library's extension mechanism)
- [Layers](packages/graph/docs/rendering/layers.md): Layer order and lifecycle
- [Optional minimap](packages/graph-minimap/README.md): Add the Canvas 2D minimap with `@gravity-ui/graph-minimap`
- [ELK Auto-layout](packages/graph-elk/README.md): Laying out a graph with ELK through `@gravity-ui/graph-elk`
- [Custom Layer Examples](packages/graph/docs/system/component-rendering-lifecycle.md): Examples of custom layer implementation
- [Event System & Interactions](packages/graph/docs/system/events.md): Working with events and user interactions
- [Graph Configuration](packages/graph/docs/system/graph-settings.md): Configuring graph behavior and appearance

## Core Documentation

- [Scene](packages/graph/docs/system/scene.md): Add, move and remove custom elements, handle clicks, switch renderers and export
- [Connections](packages/graph/docs/connections/webgl-connections.md): Straight lines, Béziers, polylines, ports, hit testing and shader effects
- [Tags and styles](packages/graph/docs/system/tags-and-styles.md): Style named parts and interaction states
- [Public API](packages/graph/docs/system/public_api.md): Main API for interacting with the graph
- [Graph Settings](packages/graph/docs/system/graph-settings.md): Graph settings and configuration
- [Component Lifecycle](packages/graph/docs/system/component-lifecycle.md): Component and layer lifecycle management
- [Component Rendering](packages/graph/docs/system/component-rendering-lifecycle.md): Component rendering process
- [Event System](packages/graph/docs/system/events.md): Event system and interactions
- [Scheduler System](packages/graph/docs/system/scheduler-system.md): Scheduling and optimization system
